categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong South New Media Co., Ltd. primarily operates in IPTV basic services, internet audiovisual services, content copyright business, and commercial operations. The company focuses on building a leading internet audiovisual platform based in Guangdong with nationwide reach, offering diverse content and integrated services across IPTV, internet TV, and cable TV channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, including AI security, intelligent content review, and multimodal generation, to empower business innovation. It operates a unified media cloud platform with integrated broadcasting control and data analytics. Key R&D projects include intelligent operation systems, big data platforms, AI-powered content review, immersive ultra-high-definition video technologies, and digital copyright protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are telecom operators such as China Mobile, China Telecom, and China Unicom in Guangdong province, as well as IPTV and cable TV platforms nationwide. The company serves residential users with IPTV and internet TV services and extends content distribution to public venues like subways and high-speed rail. It also targets vertical markets including tourism, education, automotive, and elderly care.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, and primarily serves the Guangdong market, which accounts for about 85% of its revenue. It also actively expands into other provinces across China, covering nationwide IPTV and cable TV platforms. The company aims to deepen its presence in both provincial and national markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong South New Media operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the media supply chain. It acts as an IPTV integrated broadcasting control platform operator, content aggregator, and distributor, providing content services and technology integration to telecom operators and end users. It also engages in content production and copyright licensing upstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven innovation under its 'All-in-AI' strategy, focusing on AI security, intelligent content review, and AI-generated content (AIGC). It invests in big data analytics, cloud platforms, and ultra-high-definition video technologies. Strategic R&D projects aim to enhance user experience, optimize content distribution, and expand AI applications into new business scenarios like smart homes and smart cities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees and revenue sharing from IPTV basic services and value-added audiovisual services, user subscriptions, advertising revenue, content licensing fees, and commercial operations including algorithmic advertising and e-commerce. The company also earns service fees from integration and technical support for smart TV terminals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading new media operator in China, recognized as a top 30 national cultural enterprise and a pioneer in Guangdong's new media development. It competes with other IPTV and internet TV platform operators and content providers. Its strong partnerships with major telecom operators and extensive user base position it as an industry benchmark in IPTV and internet TV sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.58 billion, a 3.63% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 657.9 million, a slight decline of 7.04%. It maintains a high profit margin and has cumulatively generated over RMB 8.15 billion in revenue and RMB 3.7 billion in net profit since listing. The company has a large user base with over 20.57 million IPTV users and 230 million internet TV app users nationwide.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique regional advantage in Guangdong with deep cultural roots and a large broadband user base. It differentiates through a comprehensive media cloud platform integrating IPTV, internet TV, and content services, empowered by AI technologies for personalized content recommendation and intelligent operation. Its extensive content library, including self-produced and licensed content, and strong operator partnerships enhance user experience and service quality, fostering high user engagement and loyalty.
